title: Pretty but damaged!
text: Pretty but damaged!. This is a lovely tray -- just the perfect color. However, either the vendor or packer at Amazon were blind because there is an obvious defect along one of the narrow sides -- the paint has scraped completely off. I really don't understand why things like this happen but I do know I am buying less and less on Amazon because of it!

product_metadata.title: American Atelier Carry 14 x 19 inches Rectangular Tray with Handle, 14 x 19 inch, Teal
features: Great for parties, celebrations and more
description: Polypropylene Trays Upgrade your serveware with this unique rectangle tray. This decorative tray has endless uses. Use it to serve drinks and food for everyday events, or special occasions and parties. This piece can also be used as an ottoman tray, a desktop organizer, a centerpiece base, a breakfast in bed tray, or a unique gift idea. The tray has a cut out on both sides for easy handling and transport. The tray is also easy to clean. Simply use a damp cloth to wipe down the surface, or wash it with warm soapy water. Made of durable materials, this serving tray will be a useful addition to your home for many years. American Atelier American Atelier has been a recognized name in home goods for the better part of a century. Its fashion forward dinnerware and home decor is what makes this brand so unique. American Atelier is committed to providing a wide selection of items in the dining and entertaining categories, and offers products made from earthenware, stoneware, and glass. Dinnerware, trays, cake plates and domes, and canister sets are but a few of the many serving pieces and tabletop items that carry the American Atelier name. Multi-Purpose Use This quality tray complements any home decor and keeps a variety of items close at hand. Use on your living room coffee table or ottoman for storing media remotes, magazines or holding your morning breakfast. Keep cosmetics and jewelry in one easy to access place. Store snacks or produce on your kitchen counter. You can even use it to keep your barware ready for your next party, to display a bouquet of flowers, and so much more.
